faqs.question: Which MG electric cars are available under A$30,000 or A$40,000 drive-away?
paragraphs: The MG4 EV Urban Essence 43 is the current MG option below A$30,000 drive-away. Below A$40,000, the shortlist also includes Urban Essence 54 and MG4 EV Essence 64. The table shows advertised September prices, not a prediction of future discounts.

Keep room in your budget for insurance and any charging installation. Choose the battery and model around your regular journeys and charging access; a higher price does not automatically make a car better value for you.
faqs.note: Price snapshot: 17 September 2026. Offers end 30 September 2026, subject to eligible sale and delivery, participating dealer stock and full offer terms. Options may cost extra. Urban prices already include the advertised A$2,000 cashback.

faqs.question: Which MG electric SUVs are available under A$50,000 or A$60,000 drive-away?
paragraphs: Under A$50,000 drive-away, MG’s September offers include MGS5 EV Essence 49, MGS5 EV Essence 62 and MGS6 EV Essence RWD. The MGS6 EV Essence AWD sits below A$60,000. Start with the space you need, then compare range and equipment within your budget.
If you need a larger boot, compare the MGS6 EV RWD with the MGS5 EV in person. Choose AWD if all-wheel drive and its additional equipment matter to you; RWD has the longer published WLTP range.
faqs.note: Price snapshot: 17 September 2026. Offers end 30 September 2026, subject to eligible sale and delivery, participating dealer stock and full offer terms. Options may cost extra.

faqs.question: Is the MG4 EV Urban a good first electric car for city driving?
paragraphs: Yes. The MG4 EV Urban can suit a first-time EV buyer and everyday city driving if its hatchback layout fits your passengers, luggage and parking space. The standard 360-degree camera and physical climate and volume controls can make everyday use easier.

Essence 43 is rated at 316 km WLTP and Essence 54 at 405 km WLTP. Compare that range with your normal week and charging access, then use a test drive to check parking, rear-seat access and your usual luggage.
faqs.note: WLTP figures are laboratory comparison values. Actual range varies with speed, weather, load, tyres and driving conditions.
faqs.keywords: first car first ev city small hatchback commute

faqs.question: Is the MGS6 EV practical for family use?
paragraphs: Yes, for families that need five seats and a large everyday luggage area. The MGS6 EV has a 581-litre rear boot, a powered tailgate and a 360-degree camera.
RWD is rated at 530 km WLTP and AWD at 485 km. Bring your child seats and pram to a test drive, and check garage fit and charging access. Families needing seven seats will need a different vehicle.
faqs.note: WLTP figures are laboratory comparison values. Actual range varies with speed, weather, load, tyres and driving conditions.
faqs.keywords: family mid size midsize value suv

faqs.question: Should I choose an MG electric hatchback, electric SUV or hybrid SUV?
paragraphs: Choose the body style around your passengers and luggage, then choose the powertrain around how you will refuel or recharge. MG electric hatchbacks, electric SUVs and hybrids answer different needs; a bigger vehicle or battery is worthwhile only when you will use the extra capability.

Fuel use on your own routes and suitable body size
Regular charging access and model-specific electric range

faqs.question: What costs should I include when comparing an MG electric hatchback over five years?
paragraphs: Add the drive-away price, charging, insurance, registration, scheduled servicing, tyres, home-charger installation and finance costs where relevant, then subtract an estimated resale value. Use the same five-year period and annual distance for every car.
Use model-specific servicing and insurance quotes. Treat resale value as a range and calculate a second scenario with more public charging, because the charging mix can materially change the result.

rows: Drive-away purchase price less estimated resale value
Annual km × wall energy use (kWh/100 km) ÷ 100 × electricity price × 5
Insurance, registration, servicing, tyres and charging equipment
Add interest and fees; avoid counting loan principal twice

faqs.note: Calculation method, not a published MG cost estimate. Use measured wall energy including charging losses, or document the adjustment from vehicle consumption. Do not assume all charging uses your home tariff.
faqs.keywords: running cost cheap servicing five year total ownership

faqs.question: How do I compare the five-year ownership cost of an MGS6 EV?
paragraphs: Compare the MGS6 EV with another electric SUV using the same five-year period, annual kilometres and home-versus-public charging mix. Add the drive-away price, insurance, registration, servicing, tyres, charging equipment and finance costs where relevant.
Calculate RWD and AWD separately, use the same resale method for every vehicle and test how the result changes with electricity prices, public charging and resale value.
faqs.note: Use model-specific quotes and a documented energy-use assumption. Treat resale value as an estimate and compare more than one scenario.
faqs.keywords: low total ownership costs electric suv cost value

faqs.question: Which MG4 EV Urban battery should I choose: 43 kWh or 54 kWh?
paragraphs: Choose Essence 43 if its 316 km WLTP range covers your regular driving and charging routine. Choose Essence 54 if the 405 km WLTP range provides useful extra margin for your journeys and justifies the price difference.

Both versions have LFP batteries and the same published boot capacity. Start with your longest regular journey, then check the current quote, charging access and equipment fitted to the exact vehicle.
faqs.note: WLTP figures are standardised laboratory comparison values. Actual range varies with speed, weather, load, tyres, accessory use and driving conditions. Confirm current pricing and specifications before ordering.
faqs.keywords: mg4 ev urban battery version range charging

faqs.question: Which MGS6 EV is better for long-distance family travel: RWD or AWD?
paragraphs: Choose RWD if the longer published range is the priority: it is rated at 530 km WLTP. Choose AWD if all-wheel drive and higher combined output matter more; it is rated at 485 km WLTP. Both list a 144 kW peak DC charging rate and 38 minutes for a 10–80% charge at 25 °C.
For family trips, compare the route, charging stops, luggage load and a sensible range buffer, then obtain a current drive-away quote for the exact variant.
faqs.note: WLTP and charging figures are standardised comparison values. Actual range and charging time vary with temperature, speed, load, battery condition, charger capability and other driving conditions.
faqs.keywords: mgs6 ev long distance family travel range charging

faqs.question: What should families check before choosing an electric SUV?
paragraphs: Start with seating, child-seat fit, usable luggage space, regular driving range, charging access and the complete drive-away price. Check the exact version because battery, drivetrain and equipment can change the comparison.
Take your usual family equipment to the test drive. Check rear-seat access, parking visibility, controls and ride comfort on roads similar to your normal journeys.

rows: Child seats and rear-seat comfort must work in practice
Boot shape matters as well as the published volume
Vehicle and charger limits both affect stop time

faqs.note: Published specifications support initial comparison but do not replace a physical fit check, test drive or current location-specific quotation.
faqs.keywords: family electric suv checklist space range charging

faqs.question: Which MGS6 EV features make everyday family use easier?
paragraphs: The MGS6 EV includes heated and ventilated front seats, a powered tailgate, a 360-degree camera and 581 L of boot space. It also has a 12.8-inch centre display, a 10.25-inch driver display and a head-up display.
Check the exact variant and use a test drive to assess child-seat access, luggage loading, visibility, ride quality and the controls your family will use most often.

rows: Loading while carrying bags or family equipment

faqs.note: Confirm the equipment fitted to the exact Australian variant and vehicle being quoted. Personal comfort and ease of use should be assessed during a test drive.
faqs.keywords: mgs6 ev family comfort features practical

faqs.question: What is the difference between the MG4 EV Urban and MG4 EV?
paragraphs: They are separate models. MG4 EV Urban is the lower-priced entry point and offers 43 kWh and 54 kWh batteries. MG4 EV Essence 64 uses rear-wheel drive and has a higher published WLTP range than either Urban version.
Choose by comparing drive-away price, useful range, drivetrain, seating and luggage space. Check the exact model name and variant on the quote before ordering.
faqs.note: WLTP figures are laboratory comparison values. Actual range varies with speed, weather, load, tyres and driving conditions.
faqs.keywords: urban vs mg4 worth buying battery

faqs.question: What is the difference between the MGS5 EV and MGS6 EV for families?
paragraphs: MGS5 EV is the compact electric SUV; MGS6 EV is the larger mid-size option. Their published boot capacities with the rear seats upright are 453 L and 581 L respectively.
Try both with the same passengers, child seats, pram and bags. Then compare current drive-away prices, useful range, equipment and whether the larger vehicle fits your parking space.

headers: Published rear boot, seats in place

faqs.note: Published capacity is a guide to storage, not a guarantee that a specific item will fit.

faqs.question: How long are an MG electric vehicle and its high-voltage battery covered by warranty?
paragraphs: An eligible privately used MG passenger vehicle first registered from 1 July 2025 has a seven-year, unlimited-kilometre standard warranty. Scheduled servicing within MG’s authorised network can activate extended cover up to 10 years or 250,000 km, whichever comes first, subject to the policy’s requirements.

High-voltage battery cover is separate: seven years or 150,000 km for manufacturing defects. The 10-year vehicle headline should not be read as 10-year battery cover. Commercial-use MG vehicles have different limits: seven years or 160,000 km, without the service-activated extension. Check the policy applicable to the vehicle’s registration date and use.

rows: Scheduled servicing and policy conditions apply

faqs.note: Distance-limited periods end at the earlier limit. Warranty eligibility, exclusions, registration date, servicing and vehicle use are governed by the current MG Australia policy. The summary excludes IM vehicles.

faqs.question: How much passenger and luggage space does the MGS6 EV have?
paragraphs: The MGS6 EV has five seats and 581 L of boot space with the rear seats upright. Folding the rear seats increases the published rear cargo capacity to 1,690 L. The front storage compartment provides 86 L in RWD or 67 L in AWD.
For a family trip, set the front seats for the actual adults, then check rear-seat comfort and load your usual pram and bags. Rear ISOFIX positions are on the two outer seats.
faqs.note: WLTP figures are laboratory comparison values. Actual range varies with speed, weather, load, tyres and driving conditions. MG quotes 10–80% DC charging in 38 minutes at 25 °C under specified conditions, with a maximum DC rate of 144 kW. Actual charging depends on the charger, battery and conditions.
faqs.keywords: five seats people luggage pram model y boot

faqs.question: Where can I find current MG EV offers and eligibility conditions?
paragraphs: Current MG EV offers and eligibility conditions are published on the MG Australia offers page. The September drive-away prices are also summarised in the budget answers on this page. The MG4 EV Urban advertised price already includes its A$2,000 cashback, so do not subtract it again. The cashback promotion requires an eligible vehicle to be sold and delivered between 11 and 30 September 2026.

A separate A$500 accessories offer applies to selected EVs and excludes MG4 EV Urban. Its terms allow a vehicle-price reduction instead of accessories. Ask the dealer to show the selected benefit and any permitted combination on one written quote, together with the exact variant, options, delivery date and final drive-away total.
faqs.note: Price snapshot: 17 September 2026. Offers end 30 September 2026, subject to eligible sale and delivery, participating dealer stock and full offer terms. Options may cost extra. Eligibility differs between promotions. Fleet, government and hire/rental exclusions apply; check the full terms.
